scopes.title: Projects, folders or organizations
scopes.description: What agents may use, with the resource prefix: projects/<project-id-or-number>, folders/<folder-number> or organizations/<organization-number>.

metricsProjects.title: Metrics projects
metricsProjects.description: The projects whose metrics gcp_metrics reads, as project IDs without projects/. Empty: the projects among the scopes.

source.title: Authentication
source.description: Existing Google sign-in uses Application Default Credentials (ADC) on this computer: if sign-in is missing or expired, test the connection and choose Sign in with Google, or run gcloud auth application-default login in a terminal. A service account key signs in as that service account.

impersonate.title: Service account to impersonate
impersonate.description: Recommended for stage and prod: calls borrow this service account's token for a few minutes. Empty: calls use the sign-in or key itself.

delegates.title: Delegation chain
delegates.description: Service accounts that pass the impersonation along, in order, as the IAM API names them. Usually empty.

lifetimeSeconds.title: Token lifetime
lifetimeSeconds.description: How long a borrowed token of the service account to impersonate lasts.

quotaProject.title: Billed project
quotaProject.description: The project whose API quota the calls use (x-goog-user-project); needs serviceusage.services.use. Empty: the credentials' own.

liveGet.title: Read current state from service APIs
liveGet.description: gcp_describe with a resource name reads it from its own service. Off: the inventory's snapshot, which can be minutes old.
